title: api-gateway: tune streaming proxy buffers, routing rules, and payload limits for OpenAI-compat tool-calls and structured output
author: Dmitri Volkov
description:
Motivation: Production traffic revealed intermittent stalls and rebuffering events when proxying large streaming payloads for OpenAI-compat endpoints (function/tool-calls and structured output). When tool-calls include large serialized tool arguments or when structured outputs are emitted in many small chunks, the streaming proxy's default memory/buffer heuristics cause head-of-line blocking and delayed flushes. This PR tightens proxy buffer thresholds, adds explicit per-route payload limits for OpenAI-compat routes, and introduces a routing rule to prefer the low-latency 'tool-calls' pool for requests that signal function/tool invocation or structured output.

What this changes: - Decrease default proxy read/write buffer high-water marks and add adaptive flush when downstream consumer is slow. - Add per-route config overrides: max_payload_bytes and max_stream_chunk_bytes for OpenAI-compat endpoints. - Routing: detect tool/function-calls (openai_compat Content-Type + tools meta) and route to dedicated low-latency pool with smaller batching windows. - Add circuit-breaker metrics and clearer logs for buffer backpressure to help SRE triage. - Integration tests for streaming proxy + structured output retries.

Compatibility and rollout: Changes are backward-compatible by default. Per-route limits are conservative (default max_payload_bytes=4MB, max_stream_chunk_bytes=64KB) and can be increased via config. Customers using extremely large tool argument payloads may see 413 responses unless they opt-in by raising limits on their route. A migration note is included in release notes.

Testing performed: unit tests for buffer logic, integration tests that simulate slow downstream consumers, end-to-end test against OpenAI-compat handler exercising function/tool calling and structured JSON streaming. Canary rollout on dedicated region for 48h with traffic shaping to validate metrics.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests updated - [x] Integration streaming tests added - [x] Docs/CHANGELOG entry - [x] Canary validation and metrics verified

References: Linear ENG-9823 ENG-10012, incident SUP-4129 (customer-facing stalls), previous PRs that touched proxy buffering (see related PRs in changelog).

release_notes: API gateway: tightened streaming proxy buffers and added conservative per-route payload limits for OpenAI-compat endpoints (function/tool-calls and structured output). Default limits: max_payload_bytes=4MB, max_stream_chunk_bytes=64KB. Customers with larger tool payloads should increase their route config or contact support. Can be rolled back by reverting feature flag 'proxy.adaptiveFlush' in config.
